chunks: Witnessing what they had done to the believers!
ai.seo_question: What will the disbelievers witness regarding their actions towards believers on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the concept of 'Shuhud' (witnessing), where the disbelievers' own deeds serve as irrefutable evidence against them, reinforcing the principle of divine justice (Adl). It underscores that on the Day of Resurrection, their actions will not only be recorded but will actively but will also testify passively, leaving no room for denial or excuse before Allah's judgment.
